title: Significant Figures Calculator
description: Count the significant figures in any number and round it to N significant figures, with the rules explained.
howto: Choose how many significant figures to round to.
Press Analyze to see the count, the rounding, and the rules applied.

faqs.a: Only if the number has a decimal point — 1500 has 2 sig figs, but 1500. has 4.
Never. In 0.00405 the zeros before the 4 only set the decimal place; the sig figs are 4, 0, 5.
Only the digits in the coefficient count — in 3.20×10^5 there are 3 significant figures.
